verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email-marketing and CRM platform, since self-hostable alternatives exist in this category, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of Brevo. Everything documented is a hosted SaaS API, SMTP relay, or SFTP data sync, which are integrations rather than self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
